description: Golden evaluation dataset for module requirement reconciliation

cases.description: Client modifies existing CARV dependent skill mapping rules
cases.module_description: Integration with CARV for candidate interviews, skill mappings, assessments, and scorecards.

existing.title: CARV Integration: Dependent Skill Mapping
bullets: Remove 'Reading Specialist' from the selectable skill list when it is no longer provided by CARV.
Automatically add the 'Reading Specialist' skill when CARV sends 'Reading' as a selected skill.

existing.title: CARV Integration: Webhook Delivery
bullets: Receive interview completion events at /api/webhooks/carv/interview-completed with HMAC SHA256 signature verification.

incoming.title: 5. CARV: Dependent Skill Mapping
bullets: Clarified that when CARV sends 'Reading', system must automatically add both 'Reading Specialist' and 'Literacy Interventionist'.
Do not expect CARV to send 'Literacy Interventionist' directly.

cases.description: A completely new functional capability is introduced
cases.module_description: Candidate onboarding, compliance documentation, I-9 verification, background checks, and license validation.

existing.title: Onboarding & Compliance: I-9 Verification
bullets: Candidates must complete Section 1 of Form I-9 no later than the first day of employment.
HR reviewer must complete Section 2 within 3 business days of first date of employment.

incoming.title: Onboarding & Compliance: Automated Driver's License OCR
bullets: The system must extract driver license number, expiration date, and state of issuance via OCR when candidate uploads license image.
If expiration date is within 30 days, trigger a warning flag for compliance reviewer.

cases.description: Client explicitly discontinues a legacy authentication method
cases.module_description: User login, SSO, multi-factor authentication, session management, and password policies.

existing.title: Authentication & Identity: SMS OTP Authentication
bullets: Users may receive a 6-digit OTP via Twilio SMS for two-factor verification upon login.
OTP expires in 5 minutes and allows a maximum of 3 failed attempts before 15-minute lockout.

existing.title: Authentication & Identity: SSO Integration
bullets: Support SAML 2.0 and OIDC single sign-on with Azure Active Directory and Okta.

incoming.title: Security & Login: SMS OTP Authentication
bullets: Client confirmed that SMS OTP authentication is being deprecated immediately in favor of authenticator apps.
Remove Twilio SMS OTP requirement and mark the feature as deprecated.

cases.description: Discussion was purely an operational team task with no product requirement
cases.module_description: Calendar management, shift scheduling, open shift broadcasts, and availability matching.

existing.title: Scheduling & Availability: Calendar Sync
bullets: Bidirectional synchronization with Google Calendar and Microsoft Outlook for confirmed shifts.

incoming.title: Action Items: Graph API Research
bullets: Dev team needs to create a Jira spike to research Outlook Graph API rate limits by Friday.
Schedule a follow-up call with Microsoft support next Tuesday.

cases.description: Meeting merely reiterates a rule that is already documented verbatim
cases.module_description: Timesheet entry, hourly rate calculations, manager approval, invoice generation, and payroll export.

existing.title: Timesheets, Payroll & Billing: Timesheet Submission Deadline
bullets: Timesheets must be submitted by Monday 9:00 AM EST for the preceding work week.
Managers have until Tuesday 5:00 PM EST to approve or reject submitted timesheets.

incoming.title: Weekly Timesheets: Submission Deadline
bullets: Confirmed that timesheets must still be submitted by Monday 9:00 AM EST for the previous week.
Manager approval deadline remains Tuesday at 5:00 PM EST.

cases.description: Client alters numeric threshold in existing cancellation policy
cases.module_description: Calendar management, shift scheduling, open shift broadcasts, and availability matching.

existing.title: Scheduling & Availability: Shift Cancellation Policy
bullets: Workers can cancel an accepted shift without penalty if done at least 24 hours prior to shift start.
Cancellations within 24 hours trigger an alert to the staffing coordinator and log an unexcused late cancellation.

incoming.title: Scheduling Rules: Cancellation Policy Update
bullets: Changed penalty-free cancellation cutoff from 24 hours to 12 hours prior to shift start.
Cancellations under 12 hours will now require coordinator approval.

cases.description: Incoming block introduces background check requirements while pruning developer sandbox tasks
cases.module_description: Candidate profiles, resumes, credentials, employee records, and status transitions.

existing.title: Candidate & Employee Management: Profile Display
bullets: Display candidate contact information, primary location, and current employment authorization status.

incoming.title: Screening & Verification: Background Check Requirements
bullets: Candidates must consent to a 7-year county criminal background check before receiving an official employment offer.
HR team needs to set up the Sterling background check sandbox account by Friday.

cases.description: Client adds an additional escalation rule to existing interview scoring block
cases.module_description: Integration with CARV for candidate interviews, skill mappings, assessments, and scorecards.

existing.title: CARV Integration: Interview Scorecard Rules
bullets: Overall score is calculated as a weighted average from 1.0 to 5.0.
Scorecards require written evaluation notes for any competency scored below 3.0.

incoming.title: CARV Assessment: Interview Scorecard Rules
bullets: If overall score is below 2.0, the system must automatically notify the recruiting director via email within 1 hour.
The weighted average scale from 1.0 to 5.0 remains unchanged.
